title: Width rewrite omits lowerable pure selections and fixed pointwise loops
observation: Both retained PReLU sources pass the original five cases and lower on gfx938; specialize_triton_warps refuses operation_domain for compare/select and loop_domain for the independent pointwise loop. The backend can already generate these structures.
proposed_change: Extend the existing explicit width rewrite to typed pure compare/select and one fixed independent pointwise loop, preserving graph, accesses, ABI, casts and existing target/store-ownership gates. Do not create a default width policy, new instruction or accuracy relaxation.
promotion_disposition: Proposed bounded applicability extension. Device correctness qualification is required; equal-budget search improvement and community-baseline performance remain separate.
